qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Dense proprietary agent network across Spain and leading market share in Brazil/LATAM bancassurance. However, full-cycle capital efficiency fails the 12% ROIC/ROE hurdle (historical 5-year median ROE <10%), as severe LatAm currency depreciation and recurring natural catastrophe losses continuously erode underwriting profits. Retail motor insurance in Iberia faces high price sensitivity and competitive churn.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (Pricing & Proof of Moat, REJECT). Multi-cycle ROE and ROIC consistently fall below the 12% threshold (5-year median ROE ~8-10%) driven by structural emerging-market currency devaluation across Latin America (especially Brazil) and elevated claims inflation in Spanish retail auto. Moat lacks empirical proof of pricing power exceeding real cost/FX inflation across full cycles.
qualitative.evidence: Mapfre's consolidated multi-year ROE has averaged below 10% across the 2018-2023 cycle, only briefly touching 12.4% during the 2024-2025 hard insurance pricing market. High geographic exposure to Latin America exposes earnings to chronic FX translation drag and catastrophe volatility, while Spanish motor lines remain intensely competitive.
